ingredients: 4 Sally Williams chocolate-coated nougat bars, chopped
Extra bars and nougat pieces, to decorate
steps: Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one by one, then the vanilla.
Fold in the flour without overmixing, then the chopped nougat.
Bake 1 hour 35 minutes, covering with foil if the top browns too fast.
Cool, turn out and decorate with icing and nougat.

resolvedChecks.note: The original method creams butter but the ingredient list omits it. 325 g matches the Vanilla Pound Cake this is based on.
